decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp, multi-sample step-like displacement in N/E/U near the end of the first window (indices 539–542), likely a permanent offset or jump; (2) a prolonged interval of elevated amplitude and complex morphology in the third window (starting ~610), featuring possible platform behavior and unresolved return dynamics due to data gaps. No other intervals show compelling cross-axis shape anomalies beyond ordinary noise or smooth trends.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample jump in N and E components around index 539–542 (N from ~10 to ~21, E from ~10 to ~20), with U dropping sharply (~-2 to ~-10); appears as a permanent offset or step change rather than smooth motion; surrounding samples show relatively stable pre-jump behavior.

Extended region of elevated variability in all axes from ~610 onward, including a possible platform-like segment (620–635) where N/E remain high (~12–14) while U fluctuates between -3 and -5; ambiguous superposition of slow drift and intermittent spikes; note missing samples at 636–641 may obscure return behavior.
